kinds.a: dried bonito · bonito flakes · 鰹節
kinds.d: Skipjack tuna boiled, smoked and dried hard, sold as whole blocks or shaved flakes.

x.d: Highest grade of katsuobushi, moulded several times and matured four to six months.
Basic boiled and smoked skipjack before any mould is applied; shaved arabushi is hadakabushi.
Katsuobushi with added mould, more common in Kanto.
Katsuobushi of Makurazaki, Kagoshima, Japan's largest producer; GI no. 168 registered 18 March 2025.
x.dt: over 300 years of history · oak and chestnut smoke

kinds.a: iriko · myeolchi · ikan bilis · dried anchovies · dried sardines
kinds.d: Small boiled and dried fish, mostly anchovies, for stock and snacks.

x.d: Western Japanese name for niboshi, the base of miso soup dashi and eaten at New Year as tazukuri.

kinds.d: Alaska pollock dried in Korea: hwangtae by winter freeze-thaw, bugeo, and half-dried kodari.

x.d: Korean pollock dried over winter by natural freeze-thaw cycles, used in hangover soup, grilled and simmered dishes.
Dried pollock used for clear soup (bugeo-guk) and jerky.

kinds.d: Filefish (Monacanthidae) fillets dried, plain or lightly seasoned and pressed, sold to eat or to grill.
Rockfish (Sebastes) salted and dried or half-dried, sold whole to grill or steam; raw rockfish is Rockfish.
Dried swim bladder of croaker, sturgeon or other fish, sold for rehydrating and cooking.
Fish cooked, shredded and dry-fried with light seasoning into a fine dry floss; a blend led by seaweed, sesame or flour is a topping in Pantry Staples.
Shark fin dried for rehydrating and cooking; trade is restricted for CITES-listed species and finning is banned in some regions.

notes: All 8 planned kinds kept. Makurazaki katsuobushi GI and honkarebushi became archetypes (old duplicates removed). Shinan dried rockfish kept once as a flat model (GI name duplicate dropped). Niboshi and Dried pollock are new kinds. Shark fin has no models; the trade-ban note is from a search snippet about the 2013 CITES decision (the NPR page returned an error) and is kept general. Not added for lack of a retrieved page: Yaizu, Yongdae-ri hwangtae (seller pages only), myeolchi and ikan bilis as separate archetypes (kept as aliases), fish maw/floss archetypes.
